name: shadcn/ui
description: A collection of accessible, customizable components you can copy into your application.
attribution: See upstream license and component dependencies before reuse.

usage: Choose a component in the upstream registry, then use its documented add command.

name: Motion

name: Repository map
description: An offline read-only tool that summarizes a repository's folders and entry points.
attribution: MotionShelf first-party example. Retain the project MIT license and copyright notice.

usage: From the cloned repository run node agents/repo-structure-map.mjs --help, or download /agents/repo-structure-map.zip, extract it, and run node repo-structure-map.mjs sample.json. Requires Node.js 20+. Bounded file discovery, ignored paths, source citations, and no code execution.
